question: Who among the following sports personalities has written, ‘Straight From My Heart: An Autobiography’?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kapil Dev**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Kapil Dev**, the legendary Indian cricketer, authored his autobiography titled "Straight from the Heart."
 
• The book provides an in-depth look into his life, career, and experiences both on and off the field.
 
• It covers his journey from a young aspiring cricketer to becoming one of the most celebrated cricket captains in India.
 
• Kapil Dev led India to its first Cricket World Cup victory in 1983, making him an iconic figure in Indian sports history.
 
• The autobiography was published to offer insights and personal anecdotes from his illustrious career and life.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kapil Dev's Cricket Career:**

 
 
• Born on 6 January 1959, Kapil Dev is regarded as one of the greatest all-rounders in cricket history.
 
• He was the captain of the Indian cricket team that won the 1983 Cricket World Cup.
 
• Kapil Dev held the record for the most Test wickets (434) at one point in his career, a record later broken by Courtney Walsh.
 
 
 
• **Achievements and Honors:**
 
 
• He was named the Indian Cricketer of the Century by Wisden in 2002.
 
• Kapil Dev was inducted into the ICC Cricket Hall of Fame in 2010.
 
• He received prestigious awards such as the Padma Shri (1982) and the Padma Bhushan (1991).
 
 
 
• **Other Contributions:**
 
 
• After retiring from cricket, Kapil Dev took up golf and participated in various tournaments.
 
• He has been involved in cricket coaching and commentary, contributing his expertise to the development of the sport.
 
 
 
• **Books by Other Sports Personalities:**
 
 
• Mary Kom's autobiography is titled "Unbreakable."
 
• Yuvraj Singh authored "The Test of My Life: From Cricket to Cancer and Back."
 
• Sania Mirza wrote "Ace Against Odds," detailing her journey in tennis.
